description.text: The French print of Electabuzz, Wizards Black Star Promo 2: one of four cards given out at French cinemas showing Pokémon: The First Movie, from 5 April 2000. Like the English cards they came sealed, but the French prints have no gold Kids WB stamp on the picture.

description.text: The French print of Arcanine, printed as "Arcanin", Wizards Black Star Promo 6. In English it was a Pokémon League promo, and French collectors' lists file it under the Pokémon League too.
